<?xml version="1.0" encoding="utf-8"?>
<package xmlns="http://schemas.microsoft.com/packaging/2012/06/nuspec.xsd">
  <metadata>
    <id>Morgana.Contracts</id>
    <version>0.29.0</version>
    <title>Morgana.Contracts</title>
    <authors>Marco De Salvo</authors>
    <license type="expression">Apache-2.0</license>
    <licenseUrl>https://licenses.nuget.org/Apache-2.0</licenseUrl>
    <projectUrl>https://github.com/mdesalvo/Morgana</projectUrl>
    <description>Morgana.Contracts is the zero-dependency wire-contract foundation for the Morgana
    conversational AI framework. It defines the DTOs exchanged between Morgana and its
    channels (channel handshake metadata and capabilities, quick replies, rich cards and
    the outbound message envelope), so the framework and every channel client share a
    single source of truth instead of duplicating the wire format.</description>
    <copyright>Marco De Salvo</copyright>
    <tags>actor-model akka-actors agents-ai ai ai-assistant chatbot intent-classification mcp multiagent</tags>
    <repository type="git" url="https://github.com/mdesalvo/Morgana.git" branch="refs/heads/main" commit="d6fb2404af58ee9aa1de65ad057d49ac4129036c" />
    <dependencies>
      <group targetFramework="net10.0" />
    </dependencies>
  </metadata>
</package>
